Zz.bar_b_note: A pleasant white/teal feathered body, but it barely reaches the trainer's height and the faint end folds into a shapeless crumpled heap, so it lacks the clear readable silhouette Palworld creatures keep.

Bo.bar_b_note: A convincing naturalistic coyote with good fur colour, scale and grounded faint poses carries it, though it reads as a real animal with no creature-design hook.

Oy.bar_b_note: Smeared low-resolution ground and wall textures, flat haze-free lighting and sparse lollipop trees sink it, and B's after frames keep the enemy banner up so the aftermath barely differs from the before frame.

Jb.bar_b_note: A well-finished, warm, appealing elder with clear face and eyes and an earthy green/brown palette that suits the Meadows villagers; it is a little more cartoon than the key art.

Eg.bar_b_note: The strong blue/gold silhouette reads well, but the blotchy camouflage-like yellow pattern looks noisy and procedural rather than authored feather markings.

Wj.bar_b_note: A large clear dragonfly silhouette with good scale, but thin glossy blue limbs and plain pale wings give it a placeholder finish next to Palworld creatures.

Iq.bar_b_note: The orange/blue sail is a strong read, but the chrome-like silver skin looks unlit-plastic and the faint end keeps the head and sail upright so the faint does not read.

Tj.bar_b_note: Long and low, it barely clears the trainer's head; crimson gill frills edge toward the reserved oxblood, and the faint end turns into a dark rolled blob with frills that look attached rather than part of the body.

Ab.bar_b_note: A nicely textured mossy turtle, but faint mid and faint end are the standing pose with the head still up, so the hurt and faint states do not read.

Rp.bar_b_note: B's glowing violet lightning wolf comes close to the Tanglevolt bar, but in A the faint frames swap to a patchy black/white material and the wolf hovers above its blob shadow.

Bt.bar_b_note: A lumpy orange crab body with knobbly back shells and no clear face, and the faint frames are almost identical to standing.

Vz.bar_b_note: The ridden frame reads well with good scale, but the same upright head-up faint poses as Ab break the hurt read.

Yk.bar_b_note: A's timber frame, diagonal brace, cap and stone footing read as built, but it still stands alone as a single panel against flat, low-detail Meadows terrain and a painted-card mountain backdrop; B is a blank glowing white board.

Oe.bar_b_note: A distinctive badger-bear with mossy stone plates, a clear face, grounded faint poses and a good ridden scale carries it.

Cx.bar_b_note: A large naturalistic dark-furred wolf with believable anatomy and grounded faint poses matches the owner style bar, though its dark value would sit low against forest ground.

top_changes.change: Author real hurt/faint animations for the shelled and low creatures (Ab/Vz turtle, Bt crab, Iq sail-back, Zz faint heap) so the head drops and the body slumps, and fix Rp-A's faint material swap and hover over its shadow

Lift the Meadows world frames (Oy, Yk): replace smeared low-resolution ground and wall textures, add Valheim-class atmospheric grade and distance haze, and group trees into groves with undergrowth so it reads like the key art

Make aftermath and build pieces read as authored: remove the enemy banners and leave site-specific aftermath in every Oy after frame, and ship the capped, braced, stone-footed homestead wall (Yk A) with neighbouring segments rather than a lone panel
